# Code Anchors: Target Root Convention

- `libs/workspace/src/target-root.ts` — the shared TypeScript implementation: the canonical named flag, extracted from argv and stripped from the remainder, defaulting to the working directory when absent or valueless.
- `libs/workspace/src/target-root.spec.ts` — coverage: the default, value extraction, a valueless flag falling back to cwd while still stripped, and the explicit value winning over cwd.
- `libs/workspace/package.json` — exposes the helper as its own subpath export alongside the package's other selectors.
- `libs/gh-toolkit/nexus_gh/create_epic.py` — Python consumer: takes the root ahead of prerequisite checks, rejects an epic file resolving outside it, and threads it as every `gh`/`git` subprocess's working directory.
- `libs/gh-toolkit/nexus_gh/create_story.py` — same convention for the story-filing script: root argument, out-of-root rejection, and every `gh` subprocess call's working directory.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/worktree.ts` — TypeScript consumer: every subcommand takes the root through the shared helper before resolving a role or a worktree path.
- `libs/workspace/src/status.ts` — consumer: the status read-out takes its checkout through the shared helper instead of a bare positional argument.
- `libs/workspace/src/docs-root.ts` — same, for the docs-root read-out.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/cli.ts` — consumer: the epic resolver's own directory argument was replaced by the shared helper.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the compiled command surface: every verb touching project state (workspace status, docs-root, epic-resolve, pr-worktree) parses the same helper before its own dispatch.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/generate-atlas.ts` — consumer: the default output location and the domain-registry path both resolve against the passed root instead of the process's own working directory.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/preflight.ts` — the ported out-of-root rejection: the target folder must resolve inside the passed root, which is named in the refusal.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/platform.ts` — the process seam bound once to the resolved root, so every platform call targets that repository and the process directory is never read or changed.
